objects.derivation: The site has yaw 0 and center [0.15,0.1,0.41]. At yaw 0, the pudding footprint is 0.0802 by 0.0463 m. Aligning its collision center at site y+0.025=0.125 puts its near y edge at 0.125-0.0463/2=0.10185, leaving 0.02655 m from the plate edge at y=0.0753; the origin remains within the accepted x=[0.1,0.2], y=[0.05,0.15] box. Its resting collision-center z is table z 0.4368 plus 0.0274/2=0.4505, which is 0.0405 m above site z; place_dz 0.042 therefore gives an approximately 0.0015 m drop. Tolerance 0.005 preserves the site margins. Lift and transport of 0.12 put the origin near z=0.53, with its bottom near 0.5169, above the plate top z=0.4557. The 180-degree symmetry follows the pudding's rectangular footprint.

The plate target origin is [0.149,0.0057,0.4393], so an unoffset placement has nominal xy origin error 0; the 0.006 m tolerance remains below the required 0.03 m distance. The plate top is z=0.4557. Since the mug collision bottom is 0.0024 m above its origin, its resting origin is 0.4557-0.0024=0.4533, or 0.0140 m above the plate origin. Thus place_dz 0.0155 releases it 0.0015 m above rest. Lift 0.15 raises its start origin from 0.4344 to 0.5844, and transport 0.15 places its origin at 0.5893 above the plate. No grasp reference is supplied, so the executor uses its collision-checked top-down candidate planner.
